Priya Singh: quick onboarding snag — new SDR (Miguel) can't get calls to appear on SDR-East dashboard and we need two voicemail drops loaded (intro + follow-up). anyone available?
Riley (salesops): I can take this. drafts: Intro (12s): "Hi, Miguel from Redwood Inference — we help teams reduce LLM inference cost & latency. Call 415-0303." Follow-up (20s): "Hey, Miguel here — circling back on improving inference performance and cost. Reply or call 415-0303 to chat."
Priya Singh: perfect. HubSpot mapping error when I used self-serve was "seat_provisioner: owner_missing"
Riley (salesops): that usually means Google account not in org. @access-bot please check miguel@redwood.dev
access-bot: Lookup miguel@redwood.dev — Google Workspace: absent. Action: create IT invite ticket (#IT-10021).
Riley (salesops): I'll add Miguel to Aircall Outbound cassette and pre-create HubSpot mapping draft. Once IT confirms invitation accept, I'll run the mapping job.
IT-admin: Created IT ticket #IT-10021 to invite miguel@redwood.dev. ETA 25m.
Kay (AE): If you need a quick workaround for demos, we can use the SDR_East_Shared seat temporarily. Not ideal but keeps calls visible.
Priya Singh: ok go ahead with shared seat in the short term. Riley, please set caller ID to SDR-East pool and DM when done.
Riley (salesops): checklist: [1] create 2 voicemail templates; [2] add Miguel to Aircall cassette; [3] create HubSpot mapping draft; [4] trigger mapping after IT accept; [5] provision temp shared seat. ETA 15m for voicemail + Aircall add.
access-bot: IT ticket updated: invited miguel@redwood.dev to Google Workspace. Status: invited.
Priya Singh: thanks all — will close once Miguel confirms calls and drops are working.
Kay (AE): also please confirm voicemail player shows regional caller ID when you test.
Riley (salesops): will verify and post back here.
